about: Stage 1 of the K4 measurement: startup timing (drivers/startup.py: start command to the first HTTP 200 on /v1/models, to the engine's ready line, and to the first streamed token of a fixed 1K request), the capacity each engine reports at startup, and the smoke checks. One cold and one warm start per engine: descriptive. 'cold' is the first start of the engine in the stage; page-cache state is recorded, not controlled (the checkpoint is larger than RAM).
